concept.title: Storage-Based Remediation Operator
concept.shortdesc: The Storage-Based Remediation (SBR) Operator is a Red Hat OpenShift add-on Operator that uses shared storage and a STONITH-style channel to reprovision unhealthy nodes. SBR works with NodeHealthCheck (NHC) to create a Custom Resource (CR) for SBR with information about the unhealthy node.

conbody.p: SBR supports the following two storage actions:

ul.li: Storage is reachable - the target can self-fence.
Storage is not reachable - the target cannot self-fence.

conbody.p: Remediation uses a StorageBasedRemediation object to reboot the unhealthy node and then evict its workloads.
